screen.title: Conversation: Hosting a radio show
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and the manager of the campus radio station.

audio.text: Hi, I'm interested in hosting a music show on the station. How do I get started?
Great! New hosts first complete two training sessions on the equipment. After that, you co-host with an experienced student for a month.
A whole month? I was hoping to have my own show this term.
You still might. Training starts next week, so if it goes well, you'd have your own slot by November. Late-night slots are the easiest to get, though.
Honestly, I don't mind staying up late. Sign me up.

questions.stem: What is the conversation mainly about?
options: What a student must do before hosting her own show
How the station decides what music to play
Why the station needs new recording equipment
When the station's first program will air

why.en: Main topic: the steps (training, then co-hosting) before she can have her own show. C misuses "equipment", which is only what the training covers.
why.tr: Ana konu: kendi programını yapabilmesi için gereken adımlar (önce eğitim, sonra ortak sunuculuk). C "equipment" kelimesini yanlış kullanıyor; ekipman yalnızca eğitimin konusu.
why.es: Tema principal: los pasos (formación y luego copresentar) antes de tener su propio programa. C usa mal "equipment", que solo es el contenido de la formación.

questions.stem: What does the woman imply when she says, "I don't mind staying up late"?
options: She usually prefers to study late at night
She hopes to skip the two training sessions entirely
She plans to co-host for only one week
She will accept a time slot others may not want

why.en: Implication: late-night slots are "the easiest to get", so she is willing to take a less popular time to get her own show sooner. B contradicts her agreement to sign up for the training.
why.tr: İma: gece geç saatler "the easiest to get", yani kendi programına daha erken sahip olmak için daha az tercih edilen bir saati kabul ediyor. B eğitime kaydolmayı kabul etmesiyle çelişiyor.
why.es: Implicación: las franjas de madrugada son "the easiest to get", así que acepta un horario menos deseado para tener antes su propio programa. B contradice que acepte apuntarse a la formación.
